parameters.description:
`msg-to-sparkpost-email` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your SparkPost destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own SparkPost destinations — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional SparkPost destinations bound per enrollment.

In SparkPost, register and verify the sending domain you plan to use (app.sparkpost.com/app/domains), then generate an API key with 'transmission' access from your dashboard — that's SPARKPOST_APIKEY. Set SPARKPOST_FROM_EMAIL to an address on that domain, and SPARKPOST_TO_EMAIL to the recipient's address; UnitySVC sends each message as an email transmission through SparkPost from the first address to the second.
parameters.gateway_body_template_plus: {"recipients":[{"address":{"email":"${ customer_secrets.{{ params.to_email_secret }} }"}}],"content":{"from":"${ customer_secrets.{{ params.from_email_secret }} }","subject":{* _escape_json(_body.title or "") *},"text":{* _escape_json(_body.body or "") *}}}
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment SparkPost destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to SparkPost transmissions API
parameters.summary: Send an email to your own SparkPost destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

apikey_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's SPARKPOST_APIKEY value (same format as SPARKPOST_APIKEY)

from_email_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's SPARKPOST_FROM_EMAIL value (same format as SPARKPOST_FROM_EMAIL)

to_email_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's SPARKPOST_TO_EMAIL value (same format as SPARKPOST_TO_EMAIL)
